seo.title: Multiples of 6 Speed Grid - 6 Times Table Fluency Game
seo.metaDescription: Find all multiples of 6 on a 10x10 number chart. Reinforce the 6 times table and divisibility rules for 2 and 3 in this fast math clicker.
seo.intro: A multiple of 6 must satisfy divisibility rules for both 2 and 3 simultaneously. This means a multiple of 6 is always an even number whose digits sum to a multiple of 3. On the 100 grid, exactly 16 numbers are multiples of 6. Mastering these values boosts multiplication speed and simplifies common factor calculations in elementary algebra.
seo.howToPlay: Locate and select every multiple of 6 up to 100. Correct selections turn green with a checkmark. Non-multiples flash red and cost 2 seconds. Find all 16 multiples before time expires.
seo.teacherNotes: Ask students to observe why all multiples of 6 are also multiples of 2 and 3. Have them practice verifying numbers like 78 (even, and 7 + 8 = 15, so divisible by 6).

faq.q: What is the divisibility rule for 6?
faq.a: A number is divisible by 6 if it is even and the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

faq.q: What is the highest multiple of 6 under 100?
faq.a: The highest multiple of 6 in this range is 96 (6 x 16 = 96).
